test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A @ B means ‘A is the mother-in-law of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the husband of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the brother of B’.

If G @ V # K & C % M, then how is G related to M?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

to B

 
 
 

Statement given : G @ V # K & C % M

So,

 
• G @ V → G is the mother-in-law of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1526f49102ecfb71c50c258a930dffa72e715c293d86f5f8e6c14cb4687fa2f.png] 

 
• V # K → V is the husband of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6c3f8f8e7b9718d2d5592046db7d114467a57cc299bf5f1da13093832276d40.png] 

 
• K & C → K is the mother of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5518e629ad61d1eaa9b34ca3f7471d0f5788a73c174799c6b6dff83f5f6ace2a.png] 

 
• 
 
C % M → C is the brother of M.

 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26499edca98dbce014da6efa26ffd70ee78228829fc4a0a3eaf99b3fc929f66f.png] 

Thus, G is the maternal grandmother of M.

Hence, "**Maternal grandmother**" is the correct answer.
